versions.design_input: {specimen} mapped from params (all this version reads) or the doc

benchmark_source: sim-engine/validate/benchmark v1 (pre-registered; built by another agent)
benchmark_notes: dev labelled 34419; held-out labelled 23355; unlabelled own models 7.
FishShapes lots named in exclusion lists with no row in the scorer's reference data (nothing to exclude): 94.

The scorer reads these benchmark params: standard_length_m, body_mass_kg, body_depth_over_SL, body_width_over_SL, peduncle_depth_frac, peduncle_width_frac, pectoral_len_over_SL, pectoral_area_over_SL2, pectoral_span_over_SL, pelvic_len_over_SL, dorsal_height_over_SL, anal_height_over_SL, caudal_upper_lobe_over_SL, caudal_lower_lobe_over_SL. Every other param (eye, head, jaw, mouth, pre-fin distances, caudal-fin shape, airspeed, CLmax, glide claims, organ volumes, fork length) is invisible to it.
The scorer has no lean_spec input, so items whose implausibility lives only in lean_spec (flight claims) are scored on params alone.
Genus-out: the scorer's leave-out matcher (phenotype.mjs excludeMatcher) has no genus key, so per splits.json that split is NOT RUN.
dev_note: dev is a stratified sample of 12044 of 34419 labelled items (EVAL_MAX_DEV=12000); every type with <= 60 items kept whole
genus_split: NOT RUN: the scorer's leave-out options have no genus key (phenotype.mjs excludeMatcher accepts ids, species, family, order, organism groups). splits.json: report NOT RUN rather than substitute.

criteria.text: held-out LOFO: FishShapes positives vs FishShapes standard decoys: AUC >= 0.75 and family-bootstrap lower 95 % bound > 0.50
held-out LOFO: >= 90 % of easy negatives (pooled) score below the 5th percentile of all held-out positive scores
held-out LOFO: median FishShapes positive score > 75th percentile of standard decoys (both sources)
held-out LOFO: FishBase positives vs FishBase standard decoys AUC >= 0.70
held-out LOFO: hard negatives (shuffle_one, extreme corner) vs same-source positives AUC >= 0.60
memorisation: P1 AUC under LOSO minus under LOFO <= 0.10
>= 75 % of the 12 ontogeny stages score above the median of the standard decoys
each Park & Choi / Makiguchi specimen scores above the 25th percentile of FishShapes positives
Lean controls (real Park & Choi specimens, realistic claims) are not ranked below any law-breaker

value.note: the scorer has no input for flight claims, so a control is scored on the same params as its specimen

exploratory.feature_subsets: For FishShapes-derived items the scorer reads exactly the shared subset (SL, mass, depth, width, peduncle depth and width) and nothing else, so restricting items to it changes no score. For FishBase items the shared subset is body depth alone, below the scorer's 4-feature minimum for the body block.

stability.what: a fixed stratified 1890-item sample of held-out items (LOFO) rescored under 5 seeds of the scorer's species split (phenotype.useSeed: changes its calibration and train pool)
